title: Scan Flip-Flop Register
constraints: Every flip-flop gets a **scan mux** in front of it. Functional mode (`se = 0`): `q <= d` on every rising edge.
Scan mode (`se = 1`): the 8 flops form a shift chain, `q <= {q[6:0], si}`. The chain output `so = q[7]` (straight from the last flop).
Synchronous reset clears q (in both modes). Must be synthesizable.
hints: It's a register whose next-state is `se ? {q[6:0], si} : d`.
Scan chains are loaded and unloaded bit-serially: 8 shift cycles load a whole test pattern, and the next 8 unload the captured response while loading the next pattern.
Keep `so` a direct flop output (no logic after it): testers need clean timing on the scan-out pin.

examples.title: unload
examples.expected: so shows the old contents MSB first
